mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of high GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP growth and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when the federal funds rate is above 4.5%, or the correlation between the federal funds rate and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative during periods of low unemployment, or the correlation between unemployment and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when housing starts increase and unemployment decreases, or the correlation between these variables and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production indicates a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive when industrial production decreases, or the correlation between industrial production and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate and an increase in GDP growth rate indicate a growing economy with tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when the federal funds rate rises and GDP growth increases, or the correlation between these variables and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high employment rate and a low unemployment rate indicate a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative when employment is high and unemployment is low, or the correlation between these variables and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when retail sales increase and unemployment decreases, or the correlation between these variables and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.05).
